info.title: Ryu Connect API
info.summary: Hosted Skills, governed tools, Composio execution and usage.
info.description:
Ryu Connect is a tenant-scoped integration edge: a shared SKILL.md catalog, governed tool search and execution over registered MCP servers and Composio, native Composio execution, a Composio usage report, its own MCP servers at /mcp and /mcp/meta, the tenant's balance, async tasks, call reviews, vendor resources and reference media.

Every `/v1` and `/mcp` request carries one tenant's runtime bearer. Hosted Connect is in early access: Ryu provisions the base URL and key; there is no self-serve signup, and the service is not distributed for self-hosting yet.

Errors are `{ code, error, ok: false }`, with the request id in `x-request-id`. Call-limit refusals add `retryAfterSeconds`. A request whose Accept names `application/problem+json` gets RFC 9457 problem details instead (the first `ConnectError` form): `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`, `code` and `docs`, plus every legacy member. A 401 carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="ryu-connect"`. Responses forwarded from an upstream in compatibility mode (`/v1/exec/tool`, `/v1/composio` and `/v1/tools/*` without native bindings, and `/mcp`) keep the upstream's body, are not normalized and are not negotiated; JSON-RPC errors from the MCP endpoints keep the JSON-RPC format. No route deduplicates writes by Idempotency-Key, so tool and action execution must not be retried blindly.

When the tenant's Composio binding sets `maxCallsPerMinute`, native Composio executions (`/v1/composio/execute`, and `/v1/exec/tool` for `composio.*` tools) carry `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` (draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11, policy `composio-calls`, a rolling 60-second window), as does their `429 rate_limited`.

post.description: Not idempotent: a repeat can run the tool twice, so the SDK never retries it on a network error or 5xx. A refusal (402, 429, 503 metering_unavailable) happens before the tool runs. In compatibility mode the Gateway reports its own refusals and tool errors as HTTP 200 with `ok: false` and `error`.

The tenant's binding decides the account, user, toolkit version and credential. Not idempotent; the SDK never retries it on a network error or 5xx. Answers 503 native_composio_unavailable without native bindings.

post.summary: Upload a reference file behind an expiring public URL
post.description: The body is the raw file and `Content-Type` names its type; Connect checks the bytes against it. The answer carries the download URL once. Quotas on file size, live files per tenant and total storage apply. Answers 404 when the deployment hosts no reference media.

parameters.name: x-ryu-media-ttl
parameters.description: How long the file stays up, in whole seconds from 60 up to the deployment's maximum.

get.summary: List the tenant's live reference media
get.description: Lists the tenant's live reference files with their type, size and expiry. The public download URL is returned only by the upload. Answers 404 when the deployment hosts no reference media.

Public: no bearer. The unguessable, expiring token in the URL the upload returned is the capability. Serves the file as an attachment with its stored type, under sandbox headers, and supports one `Range` per request. `HEAD` answers the headers only.

parameters.description: The unguessable download token in the URL the upload returned; the file is public until it expires.

RuntimeBearer.description: One tenant's runtime key, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Every operation in this document uses it.

ManagementBearer.description: A tenant's management key for account linking and trigger administration. Those routes are not in this document yet.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above the route's cap are clamped to it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retried write safe (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header/). A Structured Field String (`"<key>"`) of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters; a bare token is also accepted. Keys are scoped to the presented credential (the `Authorization` header, or `x-api-key` when no `Authorization` is sent), method and path, and expire after 24 hours. A request is the same when its query string, `Content-Type` and body match. A repeat of the same request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a different request answers 422; a repeat while the first request is in flight answers 409. Only 2xx, 400, 404, 409 and 422 outcomes are stored.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Makes a retried write safe (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header/). A Structured Field String (`"<key>"`) of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters; a bare token is also accepted. Keys are scoped to the presented credential (the `Authorization` header, or `x-api-key` when no `Authorization` is sent), method and path, and expire after 24 hours. A request is the same when its query string, `Content-Type` and body match. A repeat of the same request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a different request answers 422; a repeat while the first request is in flight answers 409. Only 2xx, 400, 404, 409 and 422 outcomes are stored.

RateLimit.description: Remaining quota for the policy in effect, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";r=0;t=30`). Sent by the limiters that expose a remaining count; the per-key API limiter does not yet, so a 429 here may carry no rate-limit fields.

RateLimitPolicy.description: The quota policy, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";q=100;w=60`).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 §10.2.3), when the server knows it.

Deprecation.description: Present only on a deprecated route: when it was or will be deprecated, as an RFC 9745 Structured Field Date (`@<unix seconds>`). No route is deprecated today.

Sunset.description: Present only on a deprecated route with a removal date: the HTTP-date after which it may stop responding (RFC 8594).

Link.description: On a deprecated route, `rel="deprecation"` links the versioning and deprecation policy (RFC 9745 §3) and `rel="successor-version"` the replacement.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is a replay stored for the request's `Idempotency-Key`.

WWWAuthenticate.description: Bearer challenge (RFC 6750) naming the protected resource metadata (RFC 9728 `resource_metadata`).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457). Every member is optional in the RFC; this API's `application/problem+json` bodies always carry `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `code`, `docs` and `error`, and legacy `application/json` error bodies carry `error` (and sometimes `code`).

partial.description: The share of reviewing organizations whose calls were `partial`, from 0 to 1.

useful.description: The share of reviewing organizations whose calls were `useful`, from 0 to 1.

outcomes.description: How reviews split across the three outcomes, each organization weighted equally, once shown; else null.

rating.description: The mean rating from 1 to 5, to one decimal, each organization weighted equally, once shown; else null.

reviews.description: Reviews counted (of the last 90 days, withdrawn ones excluded).

comment.description: The comment, shown only to its author; null when none.

createdAt.description: When the call was first reviewed (ISO 8601).

endpoint.description: The catalog endpoint (evidence key) the call ran on.

issues.description: The distinct problems flagged, in alphabetical order.

outcome.description: What the call did for the reviewer.

rating.description: The call's star rating, a whole number from 1 to 5.

revision.description: 1 on the first write; each resubmission adds one.

updatedAt.description: When the review was last written (ISO 8601).

withdrawn.description: True once the review was withdrawn: it stays on record but no longer counts toward the endpoint's summary.

description.description: What the Skill is for, from its front matter.

id.description: The Skill id; pass it to `GET /v1/skills/{skillId}`.

instructions.description: The SKILL.md file, front matter included.

description.description: What the Skill is for, from its front matter.

id.description: The Skill id; pass it to `GET /v1/skills/{skillId}`.

code.description: A stable code for the failure, such as `outcome_unknown` for a task that was running when Connect stopped.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person; null when none was kept.

error.description: Why a `failed`, `canceled` or `expired` task did not finish.

expiresAt.description: The deadline by which a queued task must start.

finishedAt.description: When the task reached its final state; null while it is `queued` or `running`.

chargedMicroUsd.description: What Ryu's settlement debited for the call, in micro-USD; null until the call answers, or when Ryu does not bill it.

costMicroUsd.description: The call's price at Ryu's rates, in micro-USD, as the call disclosed it; null until the call answers.

endpoint.description: The catalog endpoint (evidence key) the call runs on; null when it has none.

ledgerRefId.description: The settlement ledger reference of the call; null until the call answers, or when Ryu does not bill it.

metered.description: True for a call on Ryu's key at a published price.

operatorAccount.description: The label of the Ryu operator account that served the call; null when none did.

perCallMicroUsd.description: The per-call price the task was accepted at.

reservedMicroUsd.description: Held against the balance while the task is queued or running.

money.description: What the task's call is priced at, holds and charges.

ok.description: Present on a single task, absent on list items.

pollUrl.description: The path that reads this task: `/v1/tasks/<id>`.

method.description: The HTTP method of the submitted call.

path.description: The Connect call path of the submitted call, with its query.

bytes.description: The size of the kept answer's body, in bytes.

contentType.description: The answer's `content-type`; null when it sent none.

outcome.description: `upstream` when the upstream answered, `connect` for Connect's own refusal.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer.

result.description: A summary of the kept answer; null until the task has one. Read the answer itself at `resultUrl`.

resultExpiresAt.description: When the kept answer is deleted, a day after the task ended; null while the task is open.

resultUrl.description: The path that reads the answer: `/v1/tasks/<id>/result`.

rung.description: The credential ladder rung the call ran on.

ryuCallId.description: The call id (`call_` and 32 hex characters) the task's call settles under; pass it to `POST /v1/reviews`.

startedAt.description: When the call started; null while the task is `queued`.

status.description: `queued` until it starts, `running`, then `completed`, `failed`, `canceled` or `expired` (still queued at its deadline).

attempts.description: Delivery attempts made so far, the first included.

lastStatus.description: The HTTP status of the latest delivery attempt; null before any.

status.description: `pending` until a delivery is answered 2xx (`delivered`) or the retries run out (`failed`); null before the task finishes.

url.description: The URL the task's completion is delivered to.

webhook.description: The task's webhook delivery; null when it named no webhook.

data.description: The tenant's tasks, newest first, at most `limit` of them.

description.description: What the tool does, from its server.

id.description: Qualified tool id: `<server>.<tool>` or `composio.<SLUG>`. Pass it to describe and exec.

kind.description: The catalog lane: `mcp` or `composio` natively; in compatibility mode Core's tool kinds, such as `builtin`, `skill` or `core-api`, also appear.

name.description: The tool's name on its server.

args.description: Compatibility mode only: Core's per-argument summary of the input.

parameters.description: The tool's JSON Schema input. Compatibility mode may omit it and send `args` instead.

shallow.description: Compatibility mode only: true when Core could not fully resolve the schema.

description.description: What the missing tool should do. Not blank.

query.description: The search that came up empty.

toolkit.description: The vendor or toolkit wanted, such as `linear`.

description.description: What the tool does, from its server.

id.description: Qualified tool id: `<server>.<tool>` or `composio.<SLUG>`. Pass it to describe and exec.

kind.description: The catalog lane: `mcp` or `composio` natively; in compatibility mode Core's tool kinds, such as `builtin`, `skill` or `core-api`, also appear.

name.description: The tool's name on its server.

partial.description: Present when some discovery lane was unavailable.

from.description: Window start, clipped to retained data.

transactionId.description: The provider's transaction id for the call.

usage.description: The usage metadata the provider's receipt reports for the call.

lines.description: One page of billed Composio calls: when (`at`), the provider `transactionId`, and its `usage` metadata.

nextCursor.description: Repeat the request with the same window and `cursor` set to it.

reason.description: `unverifiable`: the provider log is gone or cannot be verified. `expired`: lookups of the receipt kept failing until they were given up.

transactionId.description: The provider's transaction id for the call.

unresolved.description: Receipts that can never be read; first page only.
